decision.summary: A clear multi-sample downward shift in E and U begins around index 434, sustained through index 450 (and beyond), with no return observed within the allowed context [400, 485]. The onset is abrupt (E drops >15 MAD over 2 samples), interior is flat/slowly varying, but the absence of a confirmed opposing return prevents confirmation as a temporary offset. N shows only minor fluctuations, inconsistent with a rigid-body motion interpretation. Numerical jump candidates at 433 and 450 align with onset and continuation but do not resolve return ambiguity.

intervals.observation: Sustained downward offset in E and U beginning near index 434–435, with E dropping ~−16 to −18 MAD and U dropping ~−10 to −13 MAD over ~10 samples; N remains noisy but shows no coherent step. Return not observed within allowed context (ends at 485); the offset persists through index 450 and beyond, with no opposing reversal evident before end of window.
